# HR Policy and Strategy Review 2026

This document outlines critical tasks and strategic considerations for the Human Resources department in 2026.

## Key Initiatives:

*   Investigate the bonus structure for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor medical insurance based on audit recommendations.
*   Update annual leave policies based on audit findings.
*   Review annual leave policies quarterly.
*   Optimize annual leave policies for strategy 2026.
